intent: Inline cell content for datasets: text, avatar, file, payment, badge, trend, avatar group, select, progress, rating, or row actions, with optional checkbox.
useWhen: Mixed visual and label content in a row
doNotUseWhen: A full searchable dataset — use DataTable, which composes Cell
A short static text table — use Table

size.note: Avatar, AvatarGroup, and Badge map sm/md. Checkbox is always sm.

text.note: When false, hide the label (visual-only). type=text with text=false and no checkbox is an empty slot.

checkbox.note: Leading unlabeled kit Checkbox. ariaLabel is Select ${label || name || "row"}.

label.note: Text shown when text is true. For type=text this is the content.

name.note: Avatar / AvatarGroup person name; required for those types; falls back to label.

people.note: Required for avatarGroup. Passed to kit AvatarGroup, max default 3.

icon.note: Lucide catalog name. file default File, payment default CreditCard.

tone.note: Single Badge. Demos use success for Active-like, else neutral.

value.note: Trend number, progress 0-100, rating 0-5, or select value.

options.note: Required for type=select. Passed to kit Select.

actions.note: type=actions (labeled Buttons in ButtonGroup, cap 3), actionIcons (icon-only Buttons, each ariaLabel), actionMenu composes kit DropdownMenu from actions.

requirements: type=text is text (or text plus checkbox)
Avatar and AvatarGroup keep their own a11y
File and payment icons are aria-hidden; if text=false set aria-label on the cell from label or name
Trend aria-label is Up {value} or Down {value} when text is false
When checkbox, unlabeled kit Checkbox with ariaLabel Select ${label || name || "row"}
type=select uses kit Select with ariaLabel from label
type=actionIcons each icon-only Button needs ariaLabel
type=actionMenu ariaLabel is Row actions unless label is set

doNot: Do not invent DataTableCell, Tag, Trend, FileIcon, PaymentMethod, or a second Badge
Do not use Badge for trends
Do not invent local Avatar, AvatarGroup, Badge, or Checkbox — compose the kit pieces
Do not use Lucide except via LucideByName from @/ui/Button/lucideName
Do not invent a local progress bar — type=progress composes kit Progress. Do not invent Rating, StarRating, ActionCell
Do not invent a local DropdownMenu — type=actionMenu composes kit DropdownMenu
Do not invent local Select, Button, or ButtonGroup — compose the kit pieces
